scope: retrieval line foundation: train the v4 record channel to carry query-selective content, measured by a runner-level decode head; emission frozen, answer path unchanged

lineage.parent_bundles: A.5 pre-feedback bundles per seed, byte-identical
lineage.scaffold: decode_head MLP(d->2d->4), runner-level, zero-init last layer

read_code.rule: zeros(24); code[class] = 1.0; both branches receive the same code at joint_readout
read_code.injection: forward hook on joint_readout replaces its output with joint_readout(code); training, evaluation and feedback use the same path
read_code.limitation: the code carries the read's four-way answer, not the scene's pixels; a pass measures byte expression, not content-conditioned binding

criteria.question: can the existing record channel be trained so the value readout decodes the stated label AND routing distinguishes matching from distractor entities
criteria.decode_denominator: 96 fit record-decode examples (32 fit entities x 3 position labels), label argmax exact
criteria.selectivity_denominator: 32 fit pairs, route(matching entity) > route(different entity)
criteria.birth_decode: zero-initialized decode head => zero logits, fit decode at the fixed-class argmax chance (0.333 for 3 position labels), proving no content before training; monitor
criteria.answer_path: decode head is a runner-level scaffold, never in output(); A fit 32 digest bit-identical to start; structural monitor, not a capability claim
criteria.path_purity: emission 8 tensors and all non-record base tensors bit-identical to start; only the 18 record-channel tensors train
criteria.recovery: independent process reloads record channel + decode head; fit decode and selectivity digests reproduce
criteria.seed_rule: representation earned requires decode >= gate and selectivity >= gate on all three seeds
criteria.objectives: content decode CE(decode_head(read), stated label) + selectivity margin max(0, margin - (route_match - route_distractor)); combined per update
criteria.data: record-decode dataset from existing train64/fit32 entities via frozen template; train trains, fit held-out; no project corpus / Task1 / sealed reads
criteria.scaffold: decode_head MLP(d->2d->4) is runner-level, not subject structure; no new subject identity or tensors
criteria.scope_note: representation foundation only; emission not wired; C.2 (joint gate via trained readout) is a separate card

criteria_canonicalization: json.dumps(criteria, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')) utf-8 sha256
